title: Plural statements into negatives
focus: Replace on or ovat with the matching negative olla construction.

exercises.prompt: Build “Those books are not at home.” Start from “Nuo kirjat ovat kotona.” (“Those books are at home.”). Keep nuo and kirjat unchanged.
exercises.explanation: Replace ovat with eivät ole; the demonstrative and noun keep their plural number.
